entities.summary: Diocletian, a notable figure in the history of Italy, associated with The Roman Empire (180–476). Preceded by Edict of Milan and Constantine's conversion and the Edict. Their legacy influenced Edict of Milan — Constantine legalizes Christianity and Fall of the Western Roman Empire — Odoacer deposes Romulus Augustulus.
